personalInfo.name: Arun Kumar Amma
personalInfo.tagline: Building scalable enterprise backends & high-performance modern web applications.
personalInfo.availability: Available for Full-time Roles & High-Impact Freelance
personalInfo.bio: Passionate Full Stack Developer with deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot microservices, and modern React frontends. Specializing in architecting high-throughput REST APIs, optimizing relational databases, and delivering clean, responsive user interfaces that drive real business value.
personalInfo.shortBio: Java & Full Stack Engineer with 2+ years of experience crafting robust enterprise backends with Spring Boot and reactive, polished frontends with React.

services.title: Java Backend Development
services.description: Architecting high-throughput REST APIs, microservices, and secure server-side applications using Java 17/21 and Spring Boot.

services.title: Full-Stack Web Applications
services.description: End-to-end web product development connecting Spring Boot backends with modern, responsive React and Tailwind CSS frontends.

services.title: Database Design & Query Optimization
services.description: Relational database modeling with PostgreSQL & MySQL, query indexing, Redis caching integration, and JPA performance tuning.

services.title: API Integration & Bug Fixing
services.description: Diagnosing complex backend bottlenecks, fixing memory leaks, writing unit tests with JUnit/Mockito, and integrating 3rd party APIs.

blogs.title: Building Resilient Java Microservices with Spring Boot & Kafka
blogs.excerpt: A deep dive into distributed transaction management, event sourcing, and Kafka topic partitioning in enterprise Java applications.
blogs.content: Distributed microservice architectures require careful handling of transactions and event communication. In this article, we explore how Java 17, Spring Cloud, and Apache Kafka work together to maintain ACID consistency across multi-region cloud deployments...

blogs.title: Optimizing React Performance with Tailwind & Custom Hooks
blogs.excerpt: Key strategies for reducing render cycles, leveraging WebSockets in React custom hooks, and maintaining smooth 60fps animations.
blogs.content: Modern full-stack developers need frontend interfaces that respond instantaneously. Here is how we structure custom React hooks for real-time data streaming without causing unnecessary component re-renders...

testimonials.name: Suresh Reddy
testimonials.content: Arun is an exceptional Java developer. His expertise in Spring Boot microservices and query optimization reduced our backend response times by over 40%. Highly recommended!

testimonials.name: Priya Sharma
testimonials.content: Arun delivered our full-stack client portal on time with flawless code quality and a polished React UI. A true professional who understands both business and tech.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science & Engineering
education.description: Focused on Software Engineering, Data Structures & Algorithms, Operating Systems, Database Management Systems, and Object-Oriented Programming.

projects.title: FinTech Enterprise Payment Gateway
projects.subtitle: High-Throughput Distributed Microservice Architecture
projects.description: A resilient distributed payment processing system designed with Java Spring Boot, Apache Kafka event streaming, Redis caching, and PostgreSQL. Handles concurrent transaction processing with ACID compliance and JWT Spring Security authentication.
projects.longDescription: Engineered a fault-tolerant payment orchestration engine built to scale across multi-region cloud deployments. Implemented the Saga pattern for distributed transaction management, rate limiting with Redis, and Kafka topic partitioning for real-time audit event logging.
highlights: Implemented Distributed Locking using Redis Redlock algorithm to prevent race conditions during payout execution.
Built dynamic React management dashboard with real-time transaction telemetry via WebSockets.
Integrated resilience patterns using Resilience4j (Circuit Breaker, Retry, RateLimiter).

projects.title: Cloud ERP & Inventory Management System
projects.subtitle: Full-Stack Enterprise Resource Planning Platform
projects.description: Comprehensive multi-tenant warehouse & inventory tracking solution. Built with Java Spring Data JPA, React 18, Tailwind CSS, and automated PDF report generation.
projects.longDescription: An all-in-one inventory, order processing, and supplier workflow application. Offers real-time stock notifications, role-based access control (RBAC), and automated invoice PDF compilation.
highlights: Designed normalized MySQL schema with optimized indexed queries reducing fetch times by 60%.
Crafted responsive UI using React and Tailwind CSS with custom data tables and CSV export.
Configured Docker Compose multi-container setup for seamless local & cloud deployment.

projects.title: DevConnect - Developer Community & Code Hub
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Collaboration Platform for Developers
projects.description: Interactive platform where developers can share code snippets, ask technical questions, follow tech tags, and collaborate in real-time chat rooms.
projects.longDescription: Built with React, Spring Boot REST API, WebSockets, and MongoDB. Includes markdown syntax highlighting, code snippet bookmarking, and developer portfolio pages.
highlights: Implemented real-time bi-directional messaging with WebSockets and Spring Messaging.
Built rich Markdown code editor with syntax highlighting using PrismJS.
Designed JWT authentication flow with refresh token rotation.

projects.title: AI Resume & Skill Matcher Microservice
projects.subtitle: Intelligent Candidate Screening & Recommendation
projects.description: An automated resume parsing microservice built with Spring Boot, Python text parsing engine, and React frontend interface.
projects.longDescription: Parses PDF/DOCX resumes, extracts key skills, computes match scores against job descriptions using vector embeddings and keyword density algorithms.
highlights: Constructed asynchronous processing pipeline using Spring @Async and TaskExecutors.
Created drag-and-drop React interface with live upload progress and score visualization breakdown.

experience.role: Senior Full Stack Engineer / Java Developer
experience.description: Leading the core backend API development and frontend web UI for cloud-native enterprise products.
achievements: Architected and deployed 8+ Spring Boot microservices handling over 2M daily API requests with 99.9% availability.
Refactored legacy monolith SQL queries, achieving a 45% reduction in database execution times.
Built responsive client portals in React and Tailwind CSS, increasing user engagement by 35%.
Mentored junior developers, introduced JUnit/Mockito TDD practices, boosting code coverage to 88%.

experience.description: Designed RESTful web services, database schemas, and external third-party API integrations.
achievements: Developed REST APIs using Spring Boot and Hibernate for core business modules.
Implemented Spring Security with JWT tokens for multi-role user access.
Configured Redis cache layers that reduced repetitive database load by 50%.
Integrated Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to automate automated testing and artifact deployment.

experience.description: Built responsive frontend user interfaces and supported Java web applications.
achievements: Developed interactive UI components in React and HTML5/CSS3.
Connected React frontend views to Spring Boot REST endpoints.
Participated in Agile sprint planning, daily standups, and code reviews.
